title: Plan a meaningful day with room for changing capacity

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: A capacity plan protects essential arrangements and treats energy as uncertain. Immediate tolerance does not establish later sustainability; an activity can be meaningful and still need reduction or support.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Complete fictional day: existing care appointment 10:00–10:30 with confirmed transport; no treatment change. Household task: fold four clean towels, normally ten minutes, optional today. Friend offers a ten-minute text exchange at 15:00, with a shorter message welcome. Helper Ren freely offers to fold the towels tonight but no other task. The person wants contact and may defer optional work; no numerical energy budget is assumed.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Prepare full, reduced and deferred optional plans, keeping the appointment and existing care unchanged. Write the actual communication to the friend and helper before seeing the later record.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A short activity feels manageable immediately, but the next day is harder. Must the later observation be excluded because it was not the target window?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: A reduced plan may accept Ren’s towel help and send one short message; neither person owes more. Later fiction: the message and appointment occur, towels are folded by Ren, and next-day fatigue is greater for unknown reasons. Do not call same-day fit proof of sustainable capacity or diagnose its cause. Partial: record only successes. Incorrect: promise a visit despite uncertainty or assign Ren additional work.
criteria: Essential and optional demands are distinct
Later effects and causal uncertainty remain visible

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: No. Retain timing and other possible influences; use existing individualized guidance and appropriate care to review the plan. The record cannot isolate cause or justify pushing harder.
